name: Toaster
description: Provides a toast notification system based on the Sonner library, styled to match the design system
usage: Add the Toaster component to your layout or root component only once in your application, typically in the root layout
Positioned in the bottom-center of the screen by default
Integrated with Sonner toast notification library
Themed to match the application's design system via global CSS
Styling is controlled via CSS classes and semantic theme variables
Import and use the toast function from Sonner anywhere in your application to display notifications
For advanced usage, refer to the Sonner documentation at https://sonner.emilkowal.ski/
design: The Toaster component applies the following CSS classes: toast-base (applied to all toasts for base styling like padding, border-radius, shadow, default background/text color), toast-success (applied to success toasts), toast-error (applied to error toasts), toast-warning (applied to warning toasts), toast-info (applied to info toasts)

Toast styling is controlled globally via CSS classes applied by the Toaster component. You must define these classes in your global stylesheet (e.g., src/app/globals.css) using the appropriate semantic theme variables from your design system
Refer to your theme's variable definitions for the correct semantic color names
